title: First Steps
success:
Well done! <¤Calbum.name> entered the Top 10 showing the biz your promise but the critics slate the band as a 'One hit wonder'.
   <¤CBand.name> are destined to be a flash-in-the-pan so drop them and move on to the next mission.
   In the right column you can see a summary of how much points you got in this mission.
failure:
That didn't go too well. Perform and try to build up a following making your musicians more interesting to the labels and generating revenues for the band.
   Take recording seriously and use session musicians if your own artists fail you. Record a new song if the first one is a flop with the labels.

outOfMoney.text:
You're broke. The game is over.
You should manage your cash more carefully in the future.
outOfMoney.headline: Game Over

noSingersLeft.text:
You have run out of vocalists and you can't have a band without a front person.
Surely there must be at least one that meets your demands? Anyway, the game is over. Try again.
noSingersLeft.headline: No Singers Left
